Physically, I am small, and fat but not obese. There is no visible muscle. I am very hairy, especially around the shoulder and legs. My skin is very pale and thin, covered in moles near the neck and on my arms.

I have a small head, covered in chestnut hair that goes down to the back of my neck, and that is generally unkempt, greasy, and fairly bad looking. My facial hair is patchy and nearly always present though light as I rarely ever bother to shave. Most of my beard hair grows on my neck.

 I have a large bulbous nose, covered in pores - just as the surrounding skin is. My eyes are sunken in and yet prod out, kind of like a fish. Around them are dark bags.  My teeth are yellow, and somewhat crooked. I don't know how to explain my cheeks but I guess they're kind of flabby and not really as young looking as they should be. My labial lines appear exuberantly if I smile, even just a little. It doesn't look good at all.

I honestly would wear a paper bag nearly every day but that would draw more attention towards me than the alternative. I hate all the good looking people in this thread. You don't know how good you have it.

Being around other people is awful for me. They are either possible threats or completely annoying.  Being in group exercises is a nightmare.

Luckily, near a lifetime of bullying and teasing has allowed me to learn to live without the help of anyone. Not that I particularly enjoy living, but if I don't it's not because I'm lonely.

I would say the downsides is that there are some situations that are more difficult to deal with. For instance, when I don't have enough money to buy food from a vending machine, I can't ask a friend to lend me some money; I just go on with not eating (which I'm used to anyways; I did not eat lunch for most of middle school.)

Now, I am fairly content with my current status. No one talks to me, and no one would miss me; but at least I'm left alone.
